verdict.rationale: Abacum is an FP&A SaaS platform, so a documented machine interface for agents to edit forecasts is a fair axis to judge. The evidence shows no such interface: the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The in-product AI Modeler is a plain-language UI feature, not a programmatic interface an external agent could call. The Excel connector is a push/pull spreadsheet tool, not a documented agent API. The edit-history audit trail does exist, but nothing shows agent-made changes landing in it.
